issues.detail: The Greek text says 'εστησαν δυο' (they set/appointed two), but the Vietnamese translates it as 'Họ cử hai người' (They appointed two people) followed by a list of three names (Joseph/Barsabas, Justus, and Matthew). The Greek identifies only two individuals: 1) Joseph called Barsabas (who was also called Justus) and 2) Matthew. The Vietnamese structure makes it look like three distinct people were appointed.
